scope: Pinned captured DAO ELF, signed offline LiteSVM, a locally built allow-all hook program, program-created Token-2022 mints/ATAs, and a locally seeded DAO holding for burn credit; no public RPC write or live funds.
alternate_exit_fixture: The captured global CosignState signer and DAO State admin were changed locally to the disposable test key. The open control only flips admin_closed_fund from 1 to 0; the closed failure restores it to 1. This is a synthetic authorization fixture, never a real cosigner or admin signature.
